text:
The plate looks like a square side plate of about 20–22 cm. On it are boiled or steamed cauliflower florets (roughly 150 g) and a pile of dressed arugula and chard leaves (roughly 60 g), with an oily vinaigrette that I put at about 10 g.

- Cauliflower: about 40 kcal, or up to about 60 kcal if it was cooked with butter.
- Greens: about 15 kcal.
- Dressing oil: about 90 kcal.

That adds up to roughly 150–170 kcal for about 220 g of food.
